import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    logi = (params[1] + params[2]*t)*P*(1 - P/(params[3] + params[4]*t))
    rat = params[5]*P**2/(params[6] + P)
    sq = (params[7] + params[8]*t)*np.sqrt(P)
    return params[0] + logi + rat + sq + params[9]*t*P**1.5
